operative_context: Identifier values must not be modified after initial assignment
exceptions: Rent records may have status changes but the identifier itself remains constant
conflicts_or_obsolete: JIRA-ITEM-301 and JIRA-ITEM-302 discuss potential divergence between business identifier and operational identifier, indicating unresolved ambiguity about whether a single immutable identifier or multiple identifier representations are intended
gaps_or_uncertainties: Exact behavior depends on a category- or matrix-based rule that is not fully specified in the retrieved evidence.
notes: TARGET_ID R39 addresses identifier immutability as a general principle. PRIMARY evidence E1 establishes user account creation with unique identifiers. CONTEXT evidence E2, E3, E7 establish that rent records and items receive unique identifiers at creation. E5 and E6 reveal ongoing implementation uncertainty about whether business identifiers and technical identifiers should be unified or separated, which directly impacts how immutability should be tested. E9 provides supporting context on account lifecycle. The operative context captures the core immutability principle and specific format requirements found in evidence, while gaps_or_uncertainties flags the unresolved identifier strategy questions that prevent full specification of the rule's scope and application.
